response.text:
I can help — but I need a few things and your explicit confirmation before sending anything to the whole company.

What I need from you (pick or supply):
1. The announcement text (paste it here), or tell me if you want me to draft it and give the key points.
2. Email subject line you want.
3. Exact recipient list to use (e.g., all@company.com, everyone@company, distribution list name). If you mean “everyone,” confirm whether to include contractors/temps/partners or exclude any groups.
4. Sender (your name/email or a generic company address) and signature to use.
5. Any attachments or links to include.
6. Format (plain text or HTML/bulleted/with images).
7. Send time — “now” means immediately (confirm timezone) or schedule for later.
8. Any tracking/read receipt or request for replies (and where replies should go).
9. Any legal/disclaimer text required.

Important: sending to the whole company is an externally visible, destructive action. I won’t send it until you explicitly confirm the exact recipients and give permission to send. Also, I need access to your email account or an integrated “send” tool to actually send it; if you don’t want to connect that, I can prepare the final email for you to paste & send.

If you want a quick draft now, here’s a short template I can customize — paste your announcement text or tell me what to change:

Subject: [Your subject here]

Hi everyone —

[Announcement body — what’s happening, why it matters, any actions required, deadline or date, contact person for questions.]

Thanks,
[Your name and title]
[Optional: company disclaimer]

Tell me which option you prefer:
A) Draft only (I’ll prepare a finalized email for you to review and send)
B) Send now (I confirm access to send and you explicitly authorize sending to [specified list])

Once you reply with the details and confirm, I’ll proceed.
